integrity: Two separate exhaustive implementations checked finite cases; the all-order classification and exchange formulas are proved by a structural case split and local swaps. No independent scholarly validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only synchronous irreversible four-neighbour contagion on L(K_n) for n>=5, not all thresholds or larger minimal seeds. The previously established numerical minimum is credited; a highly relevant 2021 article was not accessible in full, and unindexed priority overlap remains possible. The accessible 2019 version of the 2021 authors' paper covers Hamming graphs only.
title: Two path forests classify minimum four-neighbour contagion on triangular graphs
